sequence.py: Nǐ shēnbiān yǒu liàn ài nǎo ma?
sequence.en: Is there a "love brain" in your life?

sequence.cn: 恋爱脑，就是一谈恋爱，脑子里就只剩下对方。
sequence.py: Liàn ài nǎo, jiù shì yì tán liàn'ài, nǎozi lǐ jiù zhǐ shèngxià duìfāng.
sequence.en: 恋爱脑 means the moment you fall in love, there's nothing left in your head but them.

sequence.cn: 朋友、工作、自己，全都排在后面。
sequence.py: Péngyou, gōngzuò, zìjǐ, quán dōu pái zài hòumiàn.
sequence.en: Friends, work, yourself — all pushed to the back of the line.

sequence.cn: 我的闺蜜小林，是个标准的恋爱脑。
sequence.py: Wǒ de guīmì Xiǎo Lín, shì ge biāozhǔn de liàn ài nǎo.
sequence.en: My best friend Xiao Lin is a textbook 恋爱脑.

sequence.cn: 昨天她和男朋友吵架，哭着说一定要分手。
sequence.py: Zuótiān tā hé nán péngyou chǎojià, kūzhe shuō yídìng yào fēnshǒu.
sequence.en: Yesterday she fought with her boyfriend and said through tears that she'd definitely break up.

sequence.cn: 我劝了她三个小时，嘴都说干了。
sequence.py: Wǒ quàn le tā sān ge xiǎoshí, zuǐ dōu shuō gān le.
sequence.en: I talked her through it for three hours, until my mouth went dry.

sequence.cn: 我正说到一半，男朋友的电话来了。
sequence.py: Wǒ zhèng shuō dào yíbàn, nán péngyou de diànhuà lái le.
sequence.en: I was only halfway through when the boyfriend's call came in.

sequence.cn: 她接起电话，声音一下子就变甜了。
sequence.py: Tā jiē qǐ diànhuà, shēngyīn yíxiàzi jiù biàn tián le.
sequence.en: She picked up, and her voice turned sweet in an instant.

sequence.cn: 三分钟后她说：我们和好了，你别生气啊。
sequence.py: Sān fēnzhōng hòu tā shuō: wǒmen héhǎo le, nǐ bié shēngqì a.
sequence.en: Three minutes later she said: we made up — don't be mad, okay?
